title: Truthful Production Uncertainty in Electricity Markets: A Two-Stage Mechanism
abstract: arXiv:2604.02455v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Renewable power sources have low production costs, but may result in high balancing costs due to the inherent production uncertainty. Current day-ahead markets elicit only point production profiles and neglect the degree of uncertainty associated with each generating asset, preventing the market operator from accounting for balancing costs in day-ahead dispatch and ancillary service procurement. This increases the total system cost and undermines market efficiency, especially in renewable-heavy power systems. To address this, we propose a new market clearing paradigm based on a two-stage mechanism, where producers report their production forecast distribution in the day-ahead stage, followed by the realized production in the real-time stage. translated_title: 电力市场中的真实生产不确定性：一种两阶段机制
translated_abstract: 可再生能源发电的生产成本较低，但由于固有的生产不确定性，可能导致高昂的平衡成本。当前的日前市场仅获取单一的生产预测曲线，而忽略了每个发电资产所关联的不确定性程度，这导致市场运营商无法在日前调度和辅助服务采购中考虑平衡成本。这增加了系统总成本并损害了市场效率，在可再生能源占比较高的电力系统中尤为明显。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种基于两阶段机制的全新市场出清范式：发电商在日前阶段报告其生产预测分布，随后在实时阶段报告实际生产情况。通过将VCG（Vickrey-Clarke-Groves）支付机制扩展到两阶段设定中，我们证明了该机制在激励相容性和个体理性方面具有良好的特性。
tldr: 该论文提出一种两阶段电力市场机制，让发电商在日前阶段报告生产预测分布、实时阶段报告实际出力，并通过扩展VCG支付机制实现激励相容与个体理性，使市场运营商能在日前决策中考虑平衡成本，提升系统效率。
en_tdlr: A two-stage electricity market mechanism in which producers report their production forecast distributions day-ahead and realized output in real-time, with extended VCG payments achieving incentive compatibility and individual rationality so that balancing costs are accounted for in day-ahead dispatch and ancillary service procurement.
